parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is an Express error-handling middleware. It does transport work: it maps domain error kinds to HTTP status codes (STATUS_BY_KIND), turns malformed JSON bodies (SyntaxError) into 400 responses, and returns a generic 500 for anything else. Translating errors into HTTP responses belongs to the infrastructure layer. The file holds no business rules. It never decides what makes an operation invalid, not found or conflicting. It only reads error.kind, which the domain sets. It also has no persistence or domain logic. Every responsibility fits the infrastructure role.
